Grade: Grade 2

Topic 3.4: Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how Jesus solved the fish fishermen?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MIRACULOUS CATCH OF JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MIRACULOUS CATCH OF JESUS CHRIST
Study Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how Jesus solved the fish fishermen?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the response of the ● Learners to draw and colour a fish fishermen by obeying God.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
